node.statement: Since the root fixes 0 <= epsilon <= W.epsilon_MAIN, lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger gives that the global scalar scale epsilon is at most W.K_call*epsilon and W.K_call*epsilon <= W.r_reset. Thus for t := epsilon we have 0 <= t <= W.r_reset, and the target ambient defect is epsilon = t, hence epsilon <= t.
